jobs.title: Commercial Sales Leader
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is on a mission to give software the sense of sight.

Our platform makes it easier for developers and organizations to build, deploy, and manage computer vision applications. More than 1 million developers have used Roboflow, and our customers range from startups to some of the largest companies in the world.

As computer vision moves from experimentation into production, we're building the go-to-market organization that will help companies discover where visual AI can transform their businesses and get those solutions into production.

We're looking for a Commercial Sales Leader to lead and scale our SMB and Mid-Market sales organization.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Our Commercial Sales team already has a foundation in place. Your job will be to take it to the next level.

You'll inherit a team of Account Executives across our SMB and Mid-Market segments and be responsible for developing the people, processes, and operating rhythm required to scale the organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We're looking for someone who can coach sellers, inspect deals, improve pipeline generation and conversion, and identify where our commercial sales motion needs to evolve as Roboflow grows.

You'll partner closely with Sales Development, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Field Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales leadership to build a repeatable commercial engine while maintaining the speed and experimentation of an earlier-stage company.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and develop our Commercial Sales team. Manage a team of SMB and Mid-Market Account Executives, setting a high bar for performance while investing deeply in coaching and development.

 - Scale the organization. Help determine the structure, hiring plan, territories, segmentation, and processes needed as the Commercial team grows.

 - Own the number. Be accountable for Commercial Sales performance, including pipeline, bookings, conversion, productivity, and forecast accuracy.

 - Coach the full sales cycle. Work alongside your team on qualification, discovery, demos, deal strategy, negotiation, and closing.

 - Build a repeatable sales motion. Identify what's working, what's not, and turn those learnings into processes and playbooks that help the team sell more effectively.

 - Raise the bar on pipeline generation. Build a team that doesn't wait for opportunities to arrive. Partner with SDR and Marketing leadership while creating strong outbound habits within the AE organization.

 - Create a strong operating cadence. Run effective 1:1s, pipeline reviews, forecast calls, deal reviews, and team meetings that drive accountability without unnecessary process.

 - Use data to improve performance. Understand where we're winning and losing across the funnel and translate those insights into changes in coaching, process, segmentation, or strategy.

 - Hire exceptional people. Partner with Recruiting to identify, assess, and close high-performing sellers as we continue to grow the team.

 - Develop future leaders. Build an organization where strong performers can grow into larger roles as Roboflow scales.

 - Bring the voice of the market back to Roboflow. Surface patterns from prospects and customers that can influence our product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.


WHO YOU ARE

We're less concerned with checking every box than we are with finding someone who has built high-performing sales teams and knows how to operate in a fast-moving environment.

You likely have:

 - Experience leading high-performing SMB, Mid-Market, Commercial, or Inside Sales teams in B2B software.

 - A track record of consistently hitting or exceeding team revenue targets.

 - Experience managing and developing Account Executives—not just managing the number.

 - Strong sales fundamentals and the ability to coach sellers through discovery, qualification, deal strategy, negotiation, and closing.

 - Experience building or improving a sales motion rather than simply inheriting a mature playbook.

 - A strong understanding of pipeline generation and how to create accountability around outbound prospecting.

 - The ability to use funnel metrics and sales data to diagnose problems and make decisions.

 - Experience hiring and developing high-performing sellers.

 - High standards paired with a coaching-oriented leadership style.

 - Comfort operating with ambiguity, experimenting, and changing course when something isn't working.

 - Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to work effectively with Marketing, SDR, RevOps, Customer Success, and technical teams.

 - Intellectual curiosity and an interest in learning technical products deeply enough to help your team sell them effectively.


WE'D BE ESPECIALLY EXCITED IF

 - You've led Commercial or Mid-Market sales at a technical, developer-focused, AI, data, infrastructure, or platform software company.

 - You've scaled a team through a meaningful period of company growth.

 - You've helped define segmentation or move a sales organization from a less structured motion into a repeatable one.

 - You've sold into industries like manufacturing, logistics, robotics, automotive, or other environments where software interacts with the physical world.

 - You've managed both high-velocity SMB motions and more complex Mid-Market sales cycles.

 - You've successfully developed ICs into top performers or first-time managers.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first year, you'll have:

 - Built a high-performing, accountable Commercial Sales organization.

 - Developed a clear operating cadence and consistent approach to forecasting, pipeline management, and deal inspection.

 - Improved seller productivity and conversion across the SMB and Mid-Market funnel.

 - Built a strong outbound culture alongside our inbound and product-led demand.

 - Hired and ramped additional sellers as the organization grows.

 - Developed a clear point of view on how Roboflow should segment and scale its Commercial business.

 - Created a bench of strong sellers who are growing their careers at Roboflow.

 - Established Commercial Sales as a predictable and increasingly meaningful contributor to Roboflow's growth.




WHY ROBOFLOW

Computer vision is becoming a foundational technology across industries, and we're still early in what's possible.

At Roboflow, you'll have the opportunity to build alongside a team that's defining how companies adopt visual AI. You'll have meaningful ownership over not just the performance of your team, but how our Commercial Sales organization is designed as we scale.

We're looking for someone who wants to build—not simply maintain—the next stage of our sales organization.

jobs.title: Sales Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells https://blog.roboflow.com/cancer-research-computer-vision/ to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety https://blog.roboflow.com/preventing-accidents-on-construction-sites-with-computer-vision/, digitizing floor plans https://blog.roboflow.com/floor-plan-analysis-computer-vision/, preserving coral reef populations https://blog.roboflow.com/reefos-supercharging-coral-reef-restoration-with-ai/, guiding drone flight https://blog.roboflow.com/georeferencing-drone-videos/, and much more https://roboflow.com/templates.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers love building great things with passionate teammates. We value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action—whether it's a big initiative or a small fix. Many of us have founder mindsets and thrive in Roboflow’s high-autonomy environment—some even started as side hustlers in school.




THE MANDATE

This is a frontline enterprise leadership role. You will lead a team of Enterprise Account Executives responsible for net-new logo acquisition and high-velocity expansion.

Our model is Land-and-Expand. Initial use cases convert into broader platform adoption, and it is common to build toward seven-figure deals within the first 12 months of a new enterprise relationship. Your team is expected to open the door and systematically expand the footprint.




WHAT YOU OWN


1. THE NUMBER

 - Full team quota attainment. You manage coverage, pipeline quality, and conversion discipline with extreme ownership.

 - Forecast accuracy. We operate with transparency. If the number misses, you own the post-mortem and the correction.


2. PIPELINE CULTURE

 - The Standard: Minimum 2+ net new meetings and 1+ qualified net new opportunity per rep, per week.

 - Self-Sufficiency: Pipeline is generated by the reps, not outsourced to marketing or SDRs. Outbound discipline is enforced, inspected, and coached daily. We build pipeline; we don’t wait for it.


3. DEAL QUALITY & INSPECTION

 - Rigorous Qualification: Weekly structured deal reviews. We do not tolerate "framework theater"- you are expected to surface the truth of a deal, identify gaps in real-time, and drive a credible path forward.

 - Truth over Optimism: Deals are inspected for use case alignment, economic buyer access, and implementation feasibility.


4. COACHING & STANDARDS

 - Tell, Show, Observe, Feedback: You provide live deal coaching and call reviews. You don’t just tell reps what to do; you show them.

 - Methodology: We run Command of the Message–style value selling. You are expected to uphold and evolve this standard across the team.


5. RECRUITING AS A DISCIPLINE

 - Talent Density: Proactive talent mapping and a continuous recruiting motion. You aren't just backfilling; you are upgrading the team over time with a clear, high-bar hiring rubric.




CANDIDATE PROFILE


NON-NEGOTIABLES

 - Leadership Track Record: You have led enterprise AEs and consistently hit team quota.

 - High-Performing IC Roots: You were a top-tier individual contributor before moving into leadership. You know what excellence looks like because that was you.

 - Outbound Grit: You have built outbound pipeline discipline yourself and can explain how to replicate it.

 - Deal Intuition: You can run a live, unscripted deal review and improve the deal’s probability of closing in real-time.

 - Scale Experience: You have operated in the $10M–$200M ARR growth stage where structure is evolving and the pressure is constant.


STRONG PREFERENCES

 - Experience selling AI/ML, developer tools, data infrastructure, or technical platforms.

 - Experience with $100K+ ACV and multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles.

 - Formal training in Command of the Message or an equivalent value-based methodology.

 - Background of flourishing within rigorous enterprise sales organizations.




WHY THIS IS A MEANINGFUL SEAT

Vision AI is becoming infrastructure for the physical world. Organizations are deploying vision systems in production now. They aren’t experimenting.

We are early enough that the leaders here will define how this category sells and scales. This is a durable business with real customers, real deployments, and a credible path to a meaningful exit.




THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We run a rigorous process because the seat demands it:

 1. Initial Conversation: Context, motivations, and standards.

 2. Deep Dive: Detailed walkthrough of your deals, hiring decisions, and operating rhythm.

 3. Challenge Interview: Present a 30/60/90-day plan and defend it under pressure.

 4. References: We triangulate beyond your provided list.

What You'll Receive:

💰 The target compensation for this role is $400k OTE- this uncapped.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

 - $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

 - $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

 - $350/mo AI Tools stipend

 - $150/mo team lunch stipend

 - $500/one time home office stipend

 - Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

 - Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision


EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere—and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Growth Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is building the visual cortex for AGI.

 

Every day, millions of developers and half of the Fortune 100 use Roboflow to count cells https://blog.roboflow.com/cancer-research-computer-vision/ to accelerate cancer research, improve construction site safety https://blog.roboflow.com/preventing-accidents-on-construction-sites-with-computer-vision/, digitize floor plans https://blog.roboflow.com/floor-plan-analysis-computer-vision/, preserve coral reef populations https://blog.roboflow.com/reefos-supercharging-coral-reef-restoration-with-ai/, guide drone flight https://blog.roboflow.com/georeferencing-drone-videos/, and much more https://roboflow.com/templates.

 

We have built the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. We're supported by great customers and investors, having raised over $100 million from Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, Y Combinator, and more.

 

Roboflow Labs is our applied research unit. We train our own open models (RF-DETR). We build our own benchmarks grounded in real enterprise use cases (RF100-VL). And we partner with frontier labs to deliver the training data they need to advance the capabilities that drive the most value back to our customers.

 

Behind all of it is a global network of millions of Roboflow developers who have annotated billions of images and videos to date, as well as a proven enterprise business that is exploding as AI traverses the physical economy.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Growth Lead at Roboflow Labs, you'll own the supply side of the business: the network of expert contributors who collect, annotate, verify, and evaluate the data frontier models are trained on. The network is seeded from Roboflow's existing community of millions of developers, which is a head start no other human-data company has, and it will grow into a contributor brand of its own with its own landing page, job board, onboarding, and payouts.

 - Own the contributor funnel end to end: awareness, application, screening, onboarding, activation, retention, and reactivation.

 - Build acquisition channels: convert Roboflow's registered developers into contributors, run paid and organic campaigns, build referral loops, and partner with universities, professional communities, and specialist job boards.

 - Stand up expert cohorts on demand: when Labs commits to a delivery for a frontier lab, recruit that cohort against the deadline and make the next one faster

 - Set and benchmark compensation: maintain a live view of what competing platforms pay by role and domain, and recommend rates and incentives that win the contributors we want at a cost that supports Labs' margin goals.

 - Protect the network: screening, fraud prevention, identity verification, and contributor experience so that quality and trust scale with volume

 


WHO YOU ARE

You are a scrappy, numbers-first growth operator who has grown the supply side of a marketplace before and wants to do it again. You have high agency and a bias toward action.

 - 4–8 years in growth, marketplace supply, community, or talent acquisition roles where you owned a number and the funnel behind it

 - Direct experience growing a distributed workforce: contributor, driver, host, freelancer, tutor, or annotator networks; experience at a human-data or AI training-data company is a strong plus

 - Real curiosity about how frontier models are trained and why expert human data matters; you'll need to speak fluently with the people who do it

 - Nice to have: familiarity with computer vision, robotics, or developer communities, or having been a contributor on a data platform yourself.

 


WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Roboflow is a fully distributed company with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Singapore, and Brazil. Roboflow Labs works in person in San Francisco. We host full company retreats twice per year.

 


WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE

The target compensation for this role is $150,000 – $300,000 base salary commensurate with experience as well as equity in the company. Total cash comp is expected to scale significantly with growth of Roboflow Labs.

In addition, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

 - Generous stipends covering travel, productivity, tools, meals, and office.

 - Up to 100% of your health insurance costs covered.

 - Unlimited PTO - with an annual 2 week minimum.

 - 12 weeks parental leave





NOT SURE IF THIS IS YOU?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

 


LEARN MORE ABOUT US

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Roboflow is on a mission to give software the sense of sight.

Our platform makes it easier for developers and organizations to build, deploy, and manage computer vision applications. More than 1 million developers have used Roboflow, and our customers range from startups to some of the largest companies in the world.

As computer vision moves from experimentation into production, the ecosystem around Roboflow is becoming increasingly important. Customers don't deploy computer vision in isolation — they work with consulting partners, integrate with software platforms, and deploy onto cameras, edge devices, and other hardware.

We're looking for a Head of Partnerships to build the ecosystem that helps Roboflow reach more customers and bring more computer vision applications into production.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Partnerships at Roboflow has the potential to become a significant growth engine for the business.

We're looking for someone to own that opportunity end-to-end — identifying where partnerships can create leverage, developing the relationships, structuring the commercial model, launching joint initiatives, and ultimately turning those partnerships into measurable business results.

You'll build across three critical parts of our ecosystem: consulting and systems integration partners, hardware partners, and software/technology partners.

This is a senior individual contributor role today. You won't inherit a large partnerships organization or a mature playbook. You'll be the person building it.

That means personally sourcing partners, developing relationships, negotiating agreements, figuring out what makes the partnership valuable to both sides, enabling partners, working alongside Sales on opportunities, and creating the systems that eventually allow the function to scale.

As the ecosystem grows, you'll have the opportunity to shape what the Partnerships organization becomes.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build Roboflow's partnership strategy. Determine where partnerships can create the greatest leverage across distribution, customer acquisition, deployment, product adoption, and expansion — and translate that strategy into action.

Build our consulting and SI ecosystem. Develop relationships with consulting firms, systems integrators, and implementation partners that can identify computer vision opportunities, bring Roboflow into customer engagements, and help deploy solutions at scale.

Develop strategic hardware partnerships. Build relationships across the hardware ecosystem — including cameras, edge compute, sensors, and other infrastructure our customers use to bring computer vision into the physical world.

Build software and technology partnerships. Identify platforms where integrations, co-selling, co-marketing, or broader strategic relationships can make Roboflow more valuable and expand our reach.

Personally take partnerships from idea to revenue. Source opportunities, develop the business case, build executive relationships, negotiate agreements, launch the partnership, and stay involved until it's producing meaningful results.

Create partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline. Work closely with Sales to turn partnerships into real customer opportunities rather than relationships that exist primarily on paper.

Build joint go-to-market motions. Develop co-selling, referral, marketplace, integration, and co-marketing motions based on what makes sense for each partner and ecosystem.

Enable partners to successfully sell and deploy Roboflow. Work with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architects, and Delivery to give partners the technical and commercial knowledge they need to identify opportunities and successfully bring Roboflow to customers.

Develop the operating system for Partnerships. Establish how we prioritize partners, measure performance, manage pipeline, allocate internal resources, and determine when to invest more deeply in a relationship.

Build enablement and onboarding programs for Partners. Develop the onboarding and enablement programs that set our partners up for success in our ecosystem.

Be the internal voice of the ecosystem. Bring what you're learning from partners back into Product, Engineering, Marketing, and GTM to help shape our strategy.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You've personally built and owned strategic partnerships in a high-growth technology company.

 - You have meaningful experience across consulting/SI partnerships, hardware partnerships, and software/technology partnerships.

 - You understand that those ecosystems operate differently and have personally developed partnerships within each.

 - You're a builder. You're excited by the opportunity to start with a relatively blank page rather than inherit a mature partner program.

 - You're comfortable operating as a senior IC and personally doing the work — sourcing partners, making introductions, building business cases, negotiating agreements, and driving joint opportunities.

 - You have a strong commercial orientation and can connect partnership activity directly to revenue and customer outcomes.

 - You know the difference between signing a partnership and building one that actually works.

 - You're comfortable navigating relationships from individual contributors through senior executives.

 - You can move fluidly between strategy and execution.

 - You're highly cross-functional and know how to mobilize Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Delivery around the right partnership opportunities.

 - You thrive in ambiguity and have strong judgment about where to spend your time.


WE'D BE ESPECIALLY EXCITED IF

 - You've built a partner ecosystem from an early stage rather than only operating within an established program.

 - You have experience with AI/ML, developer tools, infrastructure, data platforms, robotics, computer vision, or another technical platform.

 - You've built partnerships involving technology deployed into the physical world.

 - You've worked directly with global consulting firms or systems integrators and understand how to activate them beyond signing an agreement.

 - You have a strong partner network already that you bring with you.

 - You've built hardware relationships involving cameras, edge devices, compute, sensors, or adjacent infrastructure.

 - You've created meaningful revenue through partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities.

 - You've helped turn an early partnerships motion into something repeatable enough to eventually build a team around.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, Roboflow has a clear partnership strategy and a focused portfolio of high-value relationships across consulting, hardware, and software.

Our strongest partners aren't simply names on a webpage. They're bringing Roboflow into customer conversations, building alongside us, integrating with our platform, helping customers deploy, and creating measurable pipeline and revenue.

You've established repeatable ways to identify, evaluate, launch, and grow partnerships — giving us a foundation we can scale.

And you've demonstrated where additional investment can create leverage, helping define what the next version of Roboflow's Partnerships organization should look like.




WHY ROBOFLOW

Computer vision is inherently an ecosystem problem.

The software has to connect to cameras, compute, existing technology stacks, physical environments, and the people who design and implement those systems.

That creates an enormous opportunity for partnerships.

Rather than inheriting a mature program, you'll have the chance to decide which relationships matter, build them from the ground up, and create an ecosystem that can meaningfully expand how Roboflow reaches customers and how quickly those customers can bring visual AI into production.
